title: Choosing between device-led treatments
summary: FaceTite, Morpheus8 and EMFACE all address structure, here is how they differ.
body:
These three devices are often confused because they all work beneath the skin’s surface, but they use different mechanisms and suit different degrees of concern.

The right choice depends on the severity of laxity, the area being treated and how much downtime is acceptable to you.

It is also common for these treatments to be sequenced rather than chosen individually, for example, using EMFACE for ongoing muscle tone between periodic Morpheus8 courses for deeper remodelling.
